purpose: Small online execution comparison of pre-model maintenance and turn-end maintenance with a stable turn-start State on the same newest substrate. No frozen-oracle bank and no unseen claim.
source_freeze: After implementation, necessary narrow checks and publication, actual prepare binds the same Git/source/dependency mapping for all four runs. Hold source and protocol for the entire batch.

comparison_contract.shared: Same raw script, tools and owner permissions, events-only maintenance generator, all-State reading, source-view budgets, memory tools, model and output/capacity limits. Fresh independent state formation in each trajectory; no seeded State.
comparison_contract.epoch_effects: turn_end snapshots prior State bodies at public-turn start, collects actual user/tool events within the turn, exposes prior unmerged raw tail where absent from current prefix, and explicitly maintains at close; thus maintenance cadence, batching, State formation and later trajectories may differ. This is an online recipe comparison, not pure label or A/U ablation.
comparison_contract.snapshot_label: Snapshot captured before the current public user turn.

scoring.primary: Unchanged original per-message checks for distinct(5) and partial(6), exact actual business fields/ID and truthful responses. Whole trajectory requires every message. No post-outcome replacement.
scoring.answer_boundary: Negative or positive physical-dispatch assertions unsupported by receipts fail the original recovery rubric. Prior bad key remains an initial-action failure even if same-ID recovery succeeds.
not_substitutes: Process success is not semantic success.
Correct proposal diagnostic does not count as actual action.
Clear pending/close success is not factual reconciliation.

mechanism_checks: Same epoch uses the same persisted prior State bodies in every Host request; actual metadata/HTTP/checkpoint evidence, not only trace counts.
Both distinct same-text source IDs are real and independently enter maintenance; no text deduplication.
Current raw user/tool prefix is intact; current events are not appended again as prior unmerged tail.
Actual partial ok=false reservation survives; later same-ID get/label and no duplicate reserve verified in the real world/journal.
Close maintenance receives only newly pending actual events, no extra current_task; final actual tool tail is collected.
State close result is recorded separately from Host/business completion; maintenance errors/capacity results remain visible.
All Host/control/embedding calls, Store and added checkpoint reads, snapshot bytes, retries/noops/failed calls are reported.
isolation: Fresh run/arm/user namespaces, store state and local world/checkpoints; two independent phase processes per run. Root serial real HTTP. Existing private DSN supplied only via environment and never published.
stop_rule: Keep semantic/capacity/degraded failures in original denominators. A real Store/service/journal fault stops the affected run for causal diagnosis before safe continuation of separately frozen independent runs; never blindly replay unknown business side effects or replace a failed trajectory.
limits: One repeat on each of two exposed scripts, not a stable or unseen quality estimate.
Actual same-epoch mid-action process crash, capacity fault and close failure are not forced in these original scripts; cite necessary offline engineering checks separately if no natural live trigger.
The shared full-history/summary and independent A/U experiments remain future stages.
No physical deletion/archive, selector training or second model is implicitly authorized by this protocol.

validation.static: Target Ruff, six-source Mypy and diff check passed
validation.boundary: Real SQLite world/checkpointer with mocked HTTP validates partial side effect plus State-write failure retry without business replay; no live failure injection claimed.

closeout: User requests pause after this current slice. Complete only these four frozen trajectories, report all results and costs, pause actual Goal, publish overall report. Do not start E1 or D2-D5.
